第十五章 又是五品剑
“名誉客卿！”张羊在一旁惊呼出来，转念一想，名誉客卿又怎样，大哥绝对担得起这个职位，最重要的是这样大哥就真的和他成为一家人了。
叶石闻言也是心动，一直以来叶石都认为客卿是世界最伟大的职业，尤其是前面顶着一个‘名誉’，这类人就是传说中的只拿不做的主，完全是叶石理想中的职位。不过在见到张羊先是一惊，接下来没有任何表示的模样，叶石就有些怀疑了，难不成这‘名誉客卿’不是那么回事，得小心点别着了老狐狸的道。
俨然，张涛在叶石的眼中已经是一只老狐狸了。还真别说，张涛这一系列的表现，就像一只不愿意让到嘴美味跑掉的老狐狸。
原先张涛看见叶石眼里的喜色，显然对这‘名誉客卿’心动了，没来得及高兴，张涛就见叶石朝他儿子那看了一眼，然后眼神就变了。
轻视，戒备，张涛明显在叶石一闪而过的眼神中找到了两个重要点。张涛忍不住捂住剑，怎么他就忘了张羊这混，期待张羊说些什么张涛已经放弃了，但没想到在即将成功之际，竟然败在了这儿子身上。
“叶石小兄弟不要误会，名誉客卿是一个很轻松的职位，拥有绝对的自由，你能够继续开你的剑坊，张家也不能够强求你做些什么不愿意的事，而且你每个月还能从张家领取一定数额的矿石和金币作为俸禄。”张涛连忙解释。
什么时候，张家的少家主竟然如此低声下气的求一位铸剑师担任名誉客卿了。在高日城，只要张涛一句话放出去，将会有不少铸剑师争夺这名誉客卿之位，偏偏这叶石对这名誉客卿之位不受吸引，而对方确实有值得拉拢的实力和潜力。
这一切，都因为自己那不争气的儿子，张涛看向那还没有察觉任何情况的张羊，微微叹了口气，要是儿子像女儿那样精明，而女儿变得像儿子这样消停，那该有多好啊。
“叶大师不用担心，在下可以作保，少家主所说不假。”王海也在一旁保证。
这么一个接触到六品剑范畴的铸剑大师，王海也想与之探讨，而最简单的办法，就是同为张家客卿，那样即有沟通的渠道，又不会因为向年轻人请教而尴尬。
叶石闻言再次心动，但目光依然朝着张羊看去，看见张羊有些着急的模样，并且使劲的点头，叶石才答应道：“好吧，名誉客卿就名誉客卿吧，希望张伯父一言九鼎，再怎么说我和张羊也是兄弟，而不是什么名誉客卿。”
叶石知道张羊的单纯，这才答应下来，最后怕张涛事后不认账，叶石才连忙的加码亲情戏。连少家主也变成了张伯父，又提起了和张羊是兄弟，以后这张涛想要阴他，也要悠着点，不然他就把张羊给直接拐走。
张涛这才松了口气，最后张羊使劲点头的模样张涛也看见了，加上叶石最后的一段话，张涛不得感叹一声。
败也张羊，成也张羊，因为张羊而让叶石对名誉客卿之位有了戒备，又因为张羊和叶石的兄弟之情让叶石答应了下来。然而身为当事人的张羊，却是蒙在了鼓里，至始至终都不知道这件事情的真实经过。
“放心，我说过从今往后我们就是一家人。”张涛温和的一笑。
一旁的张羊总算有反应了，满脸醋味的看着叶石，他那老爹可从没有对他这样温慈和蔼过，尽管对大哥的本事很佩服，但这不影响一个身为儿子的心。
叶石被张羊盯着有些别扭，眼睛一转，连忙的扯开了话题，“这个，张伯父，虽然是家人了但也要明算账，我不知道名誉客卿的俸禄多少，这些我都可以收下，但铸剑的规矩不能乱，该有多少我还是会向你们收取的，半个金币都不能少。”
财迷如叶石，怎么肯吃亏，俸禄我照拿，但该有的钱一个也不能少。不然的话，不是说名誉客卿足够自由吗，家族不会强求他不愿意的事情吗。
“这是自然。”张涛微笑一声答应了下来，铸剑付钱这本来就是铸剑师应有的权利，哪怕是给家族外其他人铸剑，家族也不会干涉。

所谓客卿，就是铸剑的优先权，也就是说一旦家族需要，在不违背铸剑师信念意愿的情况下，铸剑师需要先给他们铸剑。当然，最重要的是家族的给予手段，给了那么多东西，还怕铸剑师不用心。
只可惜这次遇见的是叶石这典型的‘白眼狼’，一开始就奔着只拿不做的想法去的，就像叶石所说的，俸禄收下，该有的还是得有。
这不仅是在金钱上，还有信念、意愿和原则，哪怕叶石再贪钱，一些原则问题一样不能改。
“好了，事情暂且告一段落，我们该回去，把这件事禀告给爹才对。”张涛笑道，对于这次意外收获很是满意。
而张涛嘴中的爹，自然就是张家现代家主张诚显，尽管身为少家主，尽管拥有一个可分配名誉客气名额，但这样的大事也要禀报家主才行。
王海自然没有意见，探讨的事情不急，应该给叶石一个适应和消化的时间，“这样的话，在下等下次再来请教叶大师。”
叶石毫不客气的收下，为了树立自身形象，叶石习惯的违心说了句：“一定一定，王大师一定要来啊。”
不知被忽悠的王海信以为真，对叶石的印象再度上升，好一个不骄不躁的天才青年。
张羊在一旁看着佩服不已，连王大师都对大哥这么恭敬，不过他的剑好像还在王大师手里，见都要回去了，张羊心里却迫不及待起来，道：“王大师，你能否把巨崛剑还给我。”
王海老脸一红，习惯性的打算把剑拿回去研究，一时没记起这剑其实是有主人的，但要把这剑还回去，王海这时竟然生出几分不甘。
这不是王海要贪图巨崛剑，他想要的无非是研究几人，也好为接下来和叶石的探讨打好基础。要想探讨铸剑术，首先要了解一个人的铸剑风格、习惯不是，这样交流起来就会变得极为简单。
张涛苦笑起来，对这儿子算是没指望了，也就剩下习剑的料，其余的顺其自然吧。但这时，还是要把王大师的围解开，不然王大师还真下不了台。
叶石在一旁看出了张涛的想法，脸上一笑，提前站了出来，道：“巨崛剑是我专门为张羊加工铸造的，我想张羊还是必须先熟悉剑，才能尽快掌握。至于王大师如果愿意，我可以把另外一柄刚刚铸造完成的剑借给你。”
王海干笑几声，却是没有再把剑留在手上，递给了张羊，只是对于叶石所说的剑，王海却没有多大指望了。
从张羊那里得知叶石将剑加工铸造，而现在巨崛剑确实加工完毕，那么剩下的时间能够铸造出怎样的剑来，哪怕是四品剑，王海也不会真的放在眼里。至于说那是之前铸造一半的，王海就更不会在意了，铸剑最怕中断，哪怕事后竭尽全力的弥补，也不可能铸造出一柄好剑来，这是铸剑师中的一道铁律。
不过在王海接过叶石递来的剑，听见叶石说这剑刚出炉不久，还没有命名时还没有在意，只是之后则是露出慎重的神色，似乎这剑也非同寻常，要不是那剑上还有余温，王海差点以为这是一柄早就铸造好的宝剑。
但也因为这样，让王海不得不怀疑这剑的质地，更加小心的观摩了起来。
“张羊，你别着急着回去，我这有一些巨剑的招数，要是你想的话，我可以介绍你知道。”叶石说道。
这是叶石在确定张羊这小弟后，便有了的一点想法，神圣铸剑师的技能还能用，想必游戏中他的一些战斗技能也还在，其中就有一些巨剑类的基础技能。但不知道这个世界的人能不能学习，一个小弟，不就应该有当实验品的觉悟吗。
“要，我要。”张羊眼前一亮叫了出来。

叶石被张羊这暧昧的语句吓了一跳，背脊一阵冰凉，刚刚他还差点真以为掉进背背山了。不过对于张羊上钩，叶石还是很满意的，尤其是忽悠本事不能丢，这时叶石必须保持着传授秘技的光辉形象。
就连一旁的张涛也受到感染，一次可能是装的，两次可能是装的，但那么多次了，见到叶石始终为张羊着想，张涛也终于相信了叶石的真诚，他确实是将张羊当做兄弟了，别的不说，就凭这样叶石在他心里的印象顿时提高了几个阶段。
谁会去想，叶石忽悠已成本性，三句话中最少一句带着忽悠，想要从其中看出破绽，比起在假话中找出真话还要困难。
而就在叶石、张羊和张涛露出笑容，有聊无聊的搭着话的时候，终于听见反应过来的王海一阵低吼。
“五品剑，这竟然又是一柄五品剑！”

Chapter 15 Another fifth-grade sword
"Honorary guest minister!" Zhang Yang exclaimed from the side. Then he thought, so what about the honorary guest minister? The eldest brother can definitely shoulder this position. The most important thing is that the eldest brother will really become a family with him.
Ye Shi was also moved when he heard this. Ye Shi has always believed that guest service is the greatest profession in the world, especially when there is a 'reputation' in front of him. This kind of person is the legendary master who only takes but does not do anything. It is Ye Shi's ideal position. However, when he saw Zhang Yang, who was surprised at first and then showed no expression, Ye Shi became a little suspicious. Could it be that this 'honorary guest' was not that serious, so he had to be careful not to follow the old fox's lead.
It was as if Zhang Tao was already an old fox in Ye Shi's eyes. Not to mention, Zhang Tao's performance in this series was like an old fox unwilling to let the delicious food escape.
It turned out that Zhang Tao saw the joy in Ye Shi's eyes, and was obviously moved by this 'honorary guest'. Before he could be happy, Zhang Tao saw Ye Shi glance at his son, and then his eyes changed.
Contemptuous and wary, Zhang Tao obviously found two important points in Ye Shi's fleeting eyes. Zhang Tao couldn't help but cover his sword. How could he forget about Zhang Yang? Zhang Tao had given up in anticipation of what Zhang Yang would say, but he didn't expect that when he was about to succeed, he would be defeated by his son.
"Brother Ye Shi, please don't get me wrong. Honorary Guest Minister is a very relaxing position with absolute freedom. You can continue to open your sword workshop, and the Zhang family cannot force you to do anything you don't want to do. Moreover, you can also receive a certain amount of ore and gold coins as salary from the Zhang family every month." Zhang Tao explained quickly.
When did the young head of the Zhang family ask a swordsmith to be an honorary guest in such a humble manner? In Gaoricheng, as long as Zhang Tao lets out a word, many swordsmiths will compete for the position of honorary guest minister. However, Ye Shi is not attracted to the position of honorary guest minister, and the opponent does have the strength and potential to win over.
All this was because of his unsatisfactory son. Zhang Tao looked at Zhang Yang, who had not noticed anything, and sighed slightly. It would be great if his son was as shrewd as his daughter, and if his daughter became as calm as his son.
"Master Ye, don't worry. I can guarantee that what the young master said is true." Wang Hai also assured at the side.
Wang Hai also wanted to discuss with such a master swordsmith who was exposed to the scope of sixth-grade swords. The easiest way was to be a guest of the Zhang family, so that he would have channels of communication and would not be embarrassed by asking young people for advice.
Ye Shi was heartbroken again after hearing this, but he still looked at Zhang Yang. Seeing Zhang Yang's anxious look and nodding vigorously, Ye Shi agreed: "Okay, honorary guest ministers will be honorary guest ministers. I hope Uncle Zhang will stick to his word. No matter what, Zhang Yang and I are brothers, not honorary guest ministers."
Ye Shi knew Zhang Yang's innocence, so he agreed. In the end, he was afraid that Zhang Tao would not admit it later, so Ye Shi quickly stepped up the family drama. Even the young head of the family has become Uncle Zhang, and mentioned that he and Zhang Yang are brothers. If Zhang Tao wants to trick him in the future, he should be more relaxed, otherwise he will abduct Zhang Yang directly.
Zhang Tao breathed a sigh of relief. Zhang Tao also saw Zhang Yang's last vigorous nod, and with Ye Shi's last words, Zhang Tao couldn't help but sigh.
Zhang Yang failed, and Zhang Yang succeeded. Because of Zhang Yang, Ye Shi was wary of the position of honorary guest minister, and because of the brotherhood between Zhang Yang and Ye Shi, Ye Shi agreed. However, Zhang Yang, who was involved in the incident, was kept in the dark and did not know the true story of the incident from beginning to end.
"Don't worry, I said we will be a family from now on." Zhang Tao smiled gently.
Zhang Yang on the side finally reacted and looked at Ye Shi with a jealous face. His father had never been so kind and kind to him.Although I admire my eldest brother's ability, it does not affect my son's heart.
Ye Shi felt a little awkward being stared at by Zhang Yang. He rolled his eyes and quickly changed the subject, "Well, Uncle Zhang, although we are family members, we still have to settle accounts. I don't know how much the honorary guest minister's salary is. I can accept all of it, but the rules of sword making cannot be messed up. I will still charge you the amount, not less than half a gold coin."
Money-obsessed people are like Ye Shi, how can they be willing to suffer losses? I will take my salary, but I can’t lose any of the money I should have. Otherwise, wouldn't it mean that the honorary guest minister is free enough, and the family will not force him to do things he does not want to do.
"It's natural." Zhang Tao agreed with a smile. Paying for the sword was a swordsmith's right. Even if the sword was made for someone else outside the family, the family would not interfere.
The so-called guest minister is the priority for making swords, which means that once the family needs it, the swordsmith needs to make swords for them first without violating the swordsmith's beliefs and wishes. Of course, the most important thing is the family's means of giving. After giving so many things, I am afraid that the swordsmith will not care.
It's a pity that this time I met Ye Shi, a typical "white-eyed wolf". From the beginning, he went with the idea of ​​​​taking without doing anything. Just like Ye Shi said, after accepting the salary, you still have to have what you should have.
This is not only about money, but also about faith, will and principles. Even if Ye Shi is greedy for money, some principles cannot be changed.
"Okay, the matter is over for now. We should go back and report this matter to dad." Zhang Tao smiled, very satisfied with this unexpected gain.
The father in Zhang Tao's mouth is naturally the Zhang family's modern patriarch, Zhang Chengxian. Even though he is the young patriarch and has a quota of honors and courtesy, such a major event must be reported to the patriarch.
Wang Hai naturally had no objection. The matter discussed was not urgent. Ye Shi should be given time to adapt and digest. "In this case, I will come back to Master Ye next time for advice."
Ye Shi accepted it unceremoniously. In order to establish his own image, Ye Shi said out of habit: "Absolutely, Master Wang must come."
Unexpectedly, Wang Haixin, who was deceived, believed it to be true, and his impression of Ye Shi rose again. He was such a talented young man who was neither arrogant nor impetuous.
Zhang Yang looked on with admiration. Even Master Wang was so respectful to his elder brother. However, his sword seemed to be still in Master Wang's hand. Seeing that he was about to go back, Zhang Yang couldn't wait in his heart and said: "Master Wang, can you return the Jurisi Sword to me?"
Wang Hai's face turned red, and he planned to take the sword back to study out of habit. He didn't remember that the sword actually had an owner, but when he wanted to return the sword, Wang Hai felt a little unwilling to do so.
This is not because Wang Hai wants to covet the Giant Sword. What he wants is just to study a few people and lay a good foundation for the next discussion with Ye Shi. If you want to discuss sword-making, you must first understand a person's sword-making style and habits, so that communication will become extremely simple.
Zhang Tao smiled bitterly, thinking that he had no hope for his son, so he only had the materials to practice swordsmanship, and let the rest take its course. But at this time, we still have to clear Master Wang's siege, otherwise Master Wang really won't be able to step down.
Ye Shi saw Zhang Tao's thoughts from the side, smiled on his face, and stood up in advance, saying: "I made the Giant Sword specially for Zhang Yang. I think Zhang Yang still needs to be familiar with the sword before he can master it as soon as possible. As for Master Wang, if you are willing, I can lend you another sword that has just been cast."
Wang Hai laughed a few times, but did not keep the sword in his hand anymore and handed it to Zhang Yang. However, Wang Hai didn't have much hope for the sword Ye Shi mentioned.
I learned from Zhang Yang that Ye Shi had processed and cast the sword, and now that the Juju Sword was indeed processed, what kind of sword could be cast in the remaining time, even if it was a fourth-grade sword, Wang Hai would not really take it seriously. As for that it was cast beforeWang Hai wouldn't even care if it was half-made. Sword-making was most afraid of interruptions. Even if he tried his best to make up for it afterwards, it would be impossible to make a good sword. This was an iron rule among sword-smiths.
However, when Wang Hai took the sword from Ye Shi and heard Ye Shi say that the sword had just come out of the furnace and had not yet been named, he didn't pay much attention to it. However, he showed a cautious look afterwards. It seemed that the sword was extraordinary. If it weren't for the residual warmth on the sword, Wang Hai almost thought it was a sword that had been forged long ago.
But because of this, Wang Hai had to doubt the quality of the sword and observed it more carefully.
"Zhang Yang, don't rush back. I have some giant sword moves. If you want, I can introduce them to you," Ye Shi said.
This was Ye Shi's idea after he identified Zhang Yang as his younger brother. The skills of the Holy Swordsmith were still usable. Presumably some of his combat skills were still there in the game, including some basic giant sword skills. But I don’t know if people in this world can learn. A young man should have the consciousness to be a guinea pig.
"Yes, I want it." Zhang Yang's eyes lit up and he shouted.
Ye Shi was startled by Zhang Yang's ambiguous words, and a chill ran down his spine. Just now, he almost thought he had fallen into Beibei Mountain. However, Ye Shi was still very satisfied with Zhang Yang's taking the bait, especially since he couldn't lose his ability to cheat. At this time, Ye Shi had to maintain a glorious image of teaching secret techniques.
Even Zhang Tao on the side was affected. He might have been faking once, he might have been faking twice, but after seeing Ye Shi always thinking about Zhang Yang so many times, Zhang Tao finally believed Ye Shi's sincerity. He indeed regarded Zhang Yang as a brother. If nothing else, Ye Shi's impression in his heart suddenly improved by several stages.
Who would have thought that Ye Shi's deception was already a fact of life. At least one of the three sentences contained deception. It was more difficult to find the flaw in it than to find the truth among the lies.
And just when Ye Shi, Zhang Yang and Zhang Tao smiled and chatted in a boring way, they finally heard a low roar from Wang Hai who had reacted.
"A fifth-grade sword, this is actually another fifth-grade sword!"
